translations.kjv: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
translations.ylt: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timotheus the brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,
translations.web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

translations.kjv: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
translations.ylt: and Apphia the beloved, and Archippus our fellow-soldier, and the assembly in thy house:
translations.web: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

translations.kjv: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ!
translations.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
translations.ylt: I give thanks to my God, always making mention of thee in my prayers,
translations.web: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

translations.kjv: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
translations.ylt: hearing of thy love and faith that thou hast unto the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
translations.web: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

translations.kjv: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: that the fellowship of thy faith may become working in the full knowledge of every good thing that is in you toward Christ Jesus;
translations.web: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
translations.ylt: for we have much joy and comfort in thy love, because the bowels of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.
translations.web: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
translations.ylt: Wherefore, having in Christ much boldness to command thee that which is fit--
translations.web: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

translations.kjv: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: because of the love I rather entreat, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ;
translations.web: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
translations.ylt: I entreat thee concerning my child--whom I did beget in my bonds--Onesimus,
translations.web: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

translations.kjv: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
translations.ylt: who once was to thee unprofitable, and now is profitable to me and to thee,
translations.web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

translations.kjv: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
translations.ylt: whom I did send again, and thou him (that is, my own bowels) receive,
translations.web: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

translations.kjv: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
translations.ylt: whom I did wish to retain to myself, that in thy behalf he might minister to me in the bonds of the good news,
translations.web: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

translations.kjv: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
translations.ylt: and apart from thy mind I willed to do nothing, that as of necessity thy good deed may not be, but of willingness,
translations.web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

translations.kjv: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
translations.ylt: for perhaps because of this he did depart for an hour, that age-duringly thou mayest have him,
translations.web: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

translations.kjv: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
translations.ylt: no more as a servant, but above a servant--a brother beloved, especially to me, and how much more to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord!
translations.web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

translations.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
translations.ylt: If, then, with me thou hast fellowship, receive him as me,
translations.web: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

translations.kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
translations.ylt: and if he did hurt to thee, or doth owe anything, this to me be reckoning;
translations.web: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

translations.kjv: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
translations.ylt: I, Paul did write with my hand, I--I will repay; that I may not say that also thyself, besides, to me thou dost owe.
translations.web: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

translations.kjv: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
translations.ylt: Yes, brother, may I have profit of thee in the Lord; refresh my bowels in the Lord;
translations.web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
translations.ylt: having been confident in thy obedience I did write to thee, having known that also above what I may say thou wilt do;
translations.web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

translations.kjv: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
translations.ylt: and at the same time also prepare for me a lodging, for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted to you.
translations.web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

translations.kjv: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
translations.ylt: Salute thee doth Epaphras, (my fellow-captive in Christ Jesus,)
translations.web: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

translations.kjv: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
translations.ylt: Markus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lukas, my fellow-workmen!
translations.web: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

translations.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.
translations.ylt: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with your spirit! Amen.
translations.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
